Next, about the deadlines:
- Citacao (summons): 15 days to file the contestação (CPC Art. 335), counted in business days (Art. 219).
- Sentença (judgment): 5 days for embargos de declaração (CPC Art. 1.023), 15 days for apelação (CPC Art. 1.003 §5º).

Publication rule: Publication date = the first business day after the date it was made available on the DJe (CPC Art. 224 §2º / Law 11.419/2006 Art. 4 §3). The deadline starts on the first business day after publication (CPC Art. 224 §3 / Law 11.419 Art. 4 §4).

Note: The "início da contagem" (start of the count) is the day after publication. The count excludes the start day and includes the end day (Art. 224). If the end day is a non-business day, it is extended to the next business day (Art. 224 §1º).
